questions.explanation: After 'So' + adjective at the start, the verb comes before the subject: So loud was the noise.

wrongReasons.loudly: After 'So' we need an adjective (loud) because it describes the noun 'noise'. 'Loudly' is an adverb.
wrongReasons.louder: 'louder' is a comparative form. Here we need the basic adjective after 'So'.

questions.text: So ___ was the noise that we could not hear each other.

questions.explanation: 'Were it not for' + noun means 'if it hadn't been for'.

wrongReasons.by: The fixed phrase is 'Were it not for'.
wrongReasons.of: The fixed phrase is 'Were it not for'.

questions.text: Were it not ___ your help, I would have failed.
